The Honest Reality Most Creators Avoid

The geographic exclusion that creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh face from conventional payment platforms is systemic, not incidental. PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all operate within the traditional financial system, which means they are subject to the same correspondent banking relationships, AML compliance requirements, and risk frameworks that make international money movement difficult in certain corridors. Blockchain-based payments operate outside this system entirely. A USDT transaction from a buyer in Germany to a seller in Lagos does not pass through any correspondent bank. It does not require a compliance officer to approve the transaction corridor. It settles peer-to-peer, on-chain, in under 60 seconds. That is the structural property that makes crypto-native commerce infrastructure the correct foundation for creators in restricted markets.

The conventional wisdom is to 'work around' platform restrictions by using alternative payment methods or finding loopholes. However, this approach is short-sighted and often leads to more problems than solutions. By attempting to circumvent platform limitations, creators create a fragile ecosystem that's prone to collapse. Instead, they should focus on building a robust, platform-agnostic commerce infrastructure that puts them in control.
What the Architecture and Experience Actually Show

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the server operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. GitHub Pages is backed by Microsoft's global infrastructure. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
